profile_note: The spawn PROFILE field described the target class (local single-user developer tool) and its adversaries rather than naming quick|standard|deep. Defaulted to standard per SKILL.md §6 and overrode the threat model as instructed. Scoped run: coverage is partial by construction and the ledger records out-of-scope surfaces.

posture.note: No target code was built, run, fuzzed or executed. Evidence is source inspection of the repository plus the vendored turso 0.8.3 crate sources in the local cargo registry (read as data). No probe was re-run: the pinned measurements were treated as given per the spawn contract.

confirmed_semantics: In this fleet confirmed = a static property of source (complete trace, no visible preventing layer, named principal/resource/impact). For this run the 'source' is the design text plus the code it binds; runtime-decisive questions are needs_validation.
